headline: Fed decision day: bitcoin is back just above $81,000 ahead of the 2:00pm ET announcement, Coinbase says an analytics vendor exposed some customers' contact details, and Coinbase and Strategy report results Thursday.

market.asOf: Prices read from the CoinGecko homepage at about 11:57 UTC Wed 28 Oct (18:57 Bangkok). CoinMarketCap's charts page showed BTC about $80,884 at about the same time. 24h changes are left out because the pages we read did not say when their figures were taken. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 48 (Neutral) on CoinGecko's own index at about 11:57 UTC; CoinMarketCap's CMC Fear & Greed Index read 45 out of 100 at about the same time.

stories.title: Fed decision day: bitcoin back above $81,000 ahead of the announcement
stories.summary: The Fed announces its interest-rate decision at 2:00pm ET today (01:00 Thursday Bangkok), and most of the market expects no change. Bitcoin rose about 2% overnight to just above $81,000. Traders are watching for hints of a hike in December.
points: The Fed's range is 3.75-4.00% after a quarter-point hike last month; ABC News puts the odds of a hold at about 90%.
ABC News says odds of a quarter-point hike at the December meeting are about 75%.
Chair Kevin Warsh holds a press conference at 2:30pm ET (01:30 Bangkok), per Kiplinger.
Bitcoin rose 2% to just above $81,000, with smaller tokens leading, per CoinDesk's live blog at 7:23am ET.
US Q3 GDP and September PCE inflation are both due Thursday, per Newsquawk.

sources.label: CoinDesk: live updates ahead of the Fed
ABC News: Fed set to issue decision

stories.title: Coinbase says a vendor exposed some customers' contact details; Bithumb and Korean brokers also hit
stories.summary: Coinbase says its analytics vendor Amplitude exposed contact information for a small group of its customers. Coinbase says its own systems were not breached and customer funds are safe. In South Korea, exchange Bithumb is still working out what leaked from a break-in at its internal staff app, and two finance groups reported attacks.
points: Coinbase said the exposure affects a "small subset" of customers and gave no count; it is emailing the people affected, per Yahoo Finance and crypto.news.
Coinbase said there is no evidence of unauthorized access to its own systems, per Yahoo Finance.
A figure of more than 70,000 affected users is circulating online; Coinbase has not confirmed it, per Yahoo Finance.
Bithumb found the break-in on 27 Oct and reported it to KISA, Korea's internet security agency, and the Personal Information Protection Commission the same day, per crypto.news.
Leaked emails and phone numbers are often used for phishing: an exchange will never ask for your password or seed phrase.

stories.title: Coinbase and Strategy report Thursday after Robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55%
stories.summary: Coinbase and Strategy report their quarterly results after the US close on Thursday. Robinhood's report this week showed record total revenue, but crypto trading revenue more than halved from a year earlier.
points: Coinbase reports after the close on Thursday 29 Oct with a Q&A at 2:00pm PT (04:00 Friday Bangkok). Analysts expect a loss of about $0.23 a share on $1.21B revenue, per MarketBeat.
Strategy also reports after the close on 29 Oct, with a webinar at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Friday Bangkok), per the company.
Strategy made no bitcoin purchases from 19 to 25 Oct and bought back $204.9M of its STRC preferred shares instead, per Analytics Insight.
Robinhood's revenue was a record $1.4B, up 12%; crypto revenue was $120M, down 55%, per the company's release.

sources.label: Analytics Insight: Strategy pauses bitcoin buying

briefs.title: Strategy shareholders vote today
briefs.summary: Strategy holds a special shareholder meeting at 10:00am ET (21:00 Bangkok), online, to vote on paying dividends daily on its preferred shares, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Bitcoin ETFs took in $176M
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in about $176.0M on 27 Oct, $151.5M of it into BlackRock's IBIT, per Farside data reported by Blockchain.News.

briefs.title: CFTC reported to be looking at Polymarket again
briefs.summary: Reuters, citing unnamed sources, reports the CFTC is investigating whether Polymarket broke its 2022 settlement, per Bitcoin Magazine.

briefs.title: Whales move about $500M of bitcoin to Coinbase Prime
briefs.summary: Three large wallets sent 6,168 BTC (about $498.5M) to Coinbase Prime overnight, per Lookonchain data reported by crypto.news; there is no sign yet that it was sold.

briefs.title: USDC supply shrinks
briefs.summary: USDC's circulating supply fell $4.08B in 30 days, more than any other stablecoin, to $71.30B, per CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: New Zealand surprises with a rate hold
briefs.summary: New Zealand's central bank kept its rate at 2.75% in a 4-3 vote when markets had expected a hike, per TradingView.

calendar.event: Bank of Canada rate decision; Strategy shareholder vote
calendar.note: Rate 2.25%; a hike to 2.50% is about 80% priced (Newsquawk). Strategy's special shareholder meeting is at 10:00am ET (21:00 Bangkok), online, per crypto.news.
Range 3.75-4.00%; a hold is expected (about 90% odds, per ABC News). Chair Warsh's press conference 2:30pm ET (01:30 Bangkok), per Kiplinger. No new projections until December (Newsquawk).

calendar.note: GDP forecast 3.0% (Newsquawk); prior 2.2%. PCE 3.6% a year expected, prior 3.4%; core 3.1%, prior 3.0% (Newsquawk). ECB decision at 13:15 GMT, which is 9:15am ET (20:15 Bangkok), deposit rate 2.50%, hold expected (Newsquawk ECB preview).

Coinbase Q&A 2:00pm PT; Strategy webinar 5:00pm ET (both 04:00 Friday Bangkok). Coinbase EPS consensus -$0.23 and revenue $1.21B (MarketBeat). Token unlocks the same day: FF (~$20.0M) and CARDS (~$18.7M), per the unlock data on this page.
Around 12:00 Tokyo time Friday (financecalendar); exact time not fixed. Rate 1.25%, hold expected (Newsquawk).
At 08:00 UTC. Estimates differ: about $10.9B of bitcoin options with 'max pain' near $78,000 (TokenPost), or $12.2B with max pain near $79,000 (CryptoTicker). Max pain is not a price target.
